note: Chippewa National Forest campground in the Norway Beach Recreation Area on the south shore of Cass Lake, among mature red and white pines; the sites sit back in the woods, the nearest about 90 m from the shore. Beach, paved bike trail and the Norway Beach Visitor Center close by. --Claude
summary: rec.gov + FS page read: $26 all sites; all 45-46 sites electric 30A, back-in, 46-64 ft; 30 reservable (079-108), 15 FCFS (109-123), all FCFS after Labor Day; 2-night min (3 holiday); season May 22 - Sep 22; flush, showers, no dump. Not waterfront confirmed. Pin moves ~940 m to the loops.
flags: PIN MOVE ~940 m: stored 47.37613,-94.51679 is south-west of the campground; the catalog's 44 site points centre on 47.38370,-94.51119 (FS gives 47.382284,-94.508411, rec.gov 47.38243,-94.508506 - near the loop entrance). Move to 47.38370,-94.51119.

Not waterfront confirmed: the nearest sites (094 at 47.38486,-94.51081; 113 at 47.38360,-94.51243; 095 at 47.38453,-94.51110) are ~90-100 m from Cass Lake under continuous pine canopy; no site tagged for water. FS 'Located right on the waters of Cass Lake' and rec.gov 'Some sites overlook the scenic lake' are marketing for the recreation area.

Electric: rec.gov description says 'Thirty of the sites are equipped with electric hookups', but the FS page ('All sites in the Chippewa loop have electric hookups') and the catalog (all 45 STANDARD ELECTRIC, 30 A) say every site; the old note's '~30 with electric' was the description's count. Amperage 30 confirmed.
